faqs.question: What is Invoice Hub?
faqs.answer: Invoice Hub is a cloud-based invoicing, billing, and expense management platform designed for US-based businesses. It helps manage customers, vendors, estimates, invoices, bills, payments, OCR automation, tax calculation, and reporting in one system.

faqs.question: Who can use Invoice Hub?
faqs.answer: Invoice Hub is suitable for small and medium-sized businesses, service-based companies, product-based businesses, agencies, freelancers, and growing enterprises.

faqs.question: Is Invoice Hub cloud-based?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub is a fully cloud-based platform that can be accessed securely from anywhere with an internet connection.

faqs.question: How do I get started with Invoice Hub?
faqs.answer: You can sign up for a free trial, set up your business profile, configure taxes, add customers and products, and start creating estimates and invoices within minutes.

faqs.question: Can I customize Invoice Hub for my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub supports custom templates, branding, tax rules, payment modes, and master data configuration to match your business needs.

faqs.question: Can customers approve or reject estimates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Customers can approve or decline estimates. Once approved, estimates can be converted into invoices instantly.

faqs.question: Can I attach documents to invoices and estimates?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can upload and attach contracts, receipts, or supporting files to estimates, invoices, and bills.

faqs.question: Does Invoice Hub support partial payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub allows both full and partial payments and automatically tracks outstanding balances.

faqs.question: Will I receive notifications for unpaid invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub sends automated reminders for pending and overdue customer payments.

faqs.question: Can I manage vendor bills in Invoice Hub?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub includes a dedicated Bills module where you can add vendors, upload bills, track due dates, and manage payables.

faqs.question: Will I get notified when a bill payment is due?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub sends alerts when bill due dates approach or when payments become overdue.

faqs.question: What is OCR invoice capture?
faqs.answer: OCR (Optical Character Recognition) automatically extracts data from uploaded vendor invoices, reducing manual data entry.

faqs.question: Can I edit OCR-captured data?
faqs.answer: Yes. All OCR-captured data can be reviewed and edited before saving.

faqs.question: How does ZIP-code based tax calculation work?
faqs.answer: Invoice Hub applies tax rules based on the customer’s ZIP code, automatically calculating applicable state and local taxes.

faqs.question: Is Invoice Hub suitable for US tax requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub is built specifically for US businesses and supports complex tax scenarios.

faqs.question: What kind of reports are available?
faqs.answer: Invoice Hub provides reports for invoices, payments, bills, taxes, and overall cash flow.

faqs.question: Can I export reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reports can be exported for accounting, auditing, or internal analysis.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoice Hub uses secure cloud infrastructure, role-based access, and industry-standard security practices.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can reach our support team via email, help desk, or in-app support. Our team is committed to timely and reliable assistance.

faqs.question: Do you provide onboarding or training?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer onboarding assistance, documentation, and guided support to help you get started quickly.
